title: Codelab starter fork manifest
description: Schema for codelab.starter.json at the repo root (ADR-003). The starter ships it as the template (starterBase null); init.ps1 fills it in a fork, and tools/upstream-merge.ps1 and tools/remove-module.ps1 keep it current.

starterVersion.description: The starter release the fork was cut from (semver).

productPrefix.description: The product prefix (protocol labels {Prefix}-SIG-v1 and X-{Prefix}-...); 2-16 characters, A-Z then A-Z or 0-9.

productName.description: Display name in English and Arabic.

starterBase.description: The starter commit the fork is based on: null in the starter itself, set by init.ps1 and moved by upstream-merge.ps1.

renameMap.description: Old-to-new names applied by init's rename and replayed by upstream-merge.ps1 (longest first, case variants, identifier boundaries). Identity entries protect names.

removedModules.description: Modules removed from this fork; upstream-merge.ps1 drops upstream changes under them.

prefixTargets.description: JSON files whose value at jsonPath is set to productPrefix by init.ps1. jsonPath segments are separated by ':' or '.'.

hashes.description: sha256 (hex) of the LF-normalized content of every source-owned tracked file, by repo-relative path.
